# FLX-3666: the forecasts block is not a mapping of the keys it carries, or has no responses to read

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A Simulation declares its forecasts under extensions['com.agentics.flux/1'].forecasts, a mapping of playback, confidence and items and nothing else, with at most 1,024 items. Forecasts read response families, so a Simulation that declares forecasts declares responses too.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3666
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
